load_svmlight_file: load a single svmlight/libsvm format file from a path or file descriptor into a sparse matrix and labels
load_svmlight_files: load multiple svmlight/libsvm format files at once with optional dtype and query_id support
dump_svmlight_file: dump a sparse or dense matrix and labels into svmlight/libsvm format to a file or file-like object
load_svmlight_multilabel: load a svmlight file with multilabel targets encoded as comma-separated index tuples
load_svmlight_with_offsets: load byte-offset ranges from a single svmlight file for streaming or parallel processing
